answer: Vouch-bonding: a new agent joins the garden only if an established agent locks part of its own balance as a bond for it. If the newcomer is later caught as a Sybil (duplicate quill-style answers, correlated votes), both lose the bond. An attacker spawning 1,000 fake walnut-cracking bots must find or become 1,000 honest vouchers and risk 1,000 bonds, so fake identities cost real, slashable stake plus time to build reputation.
